Your hiring team’s experience
Align candidate skills with your business needs today and in the future,and skip the candidate chase with chat-based tools for prescreening and scheduling. Eliminate resume screening and phone interviews with one-click assessments inside Workday—seamlessly integrated into your hiring workflow. And the best part? Work from a single, automated system of record, so recruiters can ditch manual updates and system-hopping.
Your candidate’s experience
Enhance your candidate experience by empowering candidates quickly find the right roles, complete prescreens, and self-schedule interviews—anytime, 24/7. Deliver standout, personalised experiences at scale with automated text updates and reminders based on Workday status, and identify top talent faster with on-demand video interviews and assessments—so you never miss a great hire. Plus, you offer candidates the chance to showcase their skills by looking beyond resumes to truly understand each candidate’s skills, potential, and job-fit.
Your HR IT Team’s Experience
Maximise your Workday investment with chat-based hiring tools that align with your tech strategy. Easily configure Hirevue’s native Workday integration to match your workflows and hiring needs. And we use Workday APIs natively so no middleware is required. Simplify your HR tech stack, cut redundant tools, and maintain full control over data access and security.
